verdict.rationale: Entra's API surface, Microsoft Graph, has explicit versions: a GA v1.0 endpoint and a beta endpoint that warns of breaking changes. Microsoft publishes a versioning and support policy committing to declare deprecation at least 24 months before retiring a version or GA API, and the v1.0 versioning shows up in API reference URLs. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the deprecation window is honored in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy

citations.quote: Microsoft declares a version as deprecated at least 24 months in advance of retiring it
Expect breaking changes and deprecation of APIs in the beta version
The metadata document ($metadata) is published at the service root
